body.name: complete changing-support atom law
body.construction: For each \(x\in\{1,2\}\), \(z\in\{0,1\}\), and \(r\in\{0,1,2\}\), assign the four atom probabilities in \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{wit}}\), assign zero to every other tuple, and generate the observed variables by consistency; this constructs \(P_n^{\mathrm{wit}}\).
